title: dotnet-crap.json v1
description: Project configuration read from <root>/dotnet-crap.json or --config. Unknown keys are rejected; a null value is the same as an absent key.

threshold.description: Scores strictly above this fail. Finite and nonnegative.

include.description: Keep only files matching one of these root-relative globs.

exclude.description: Drop files matching any of these root-relative globs.

baseline.description: Baseline file, relative to the config file's directory.
